inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check: A caregiver who had direct access to children did not have a renewed clear background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check (26 TAC §745.621(b)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: An employee that transports children did not have the required 2 hours of transportation safety training exclusive of any requirements for orientation, pre service and annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Parent of a child on board the bus that side swept a truck while picking up other after school children was not notified immediately of the incident.  Parent was notified the following day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Health inspection expired on 11/7
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on interviews it was determined that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline on a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Operation did not notify Child Care Regulation within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Operation does not have any diaper changing stations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: When a child soils themselves, they are sent to the nurse's office to wait for their parent to pick them up or to change them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was not fire drill documentation for the month of May. This was corrected at inspection when operation conducted a fire drill during this inspection. Drill was documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Upon reviewing personnel records, there was no documentation to verify that one staff is First Aid Certified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: Upon reviewing personnel records, one staff's file did not have a Licensing Affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: I observed a tv on a rolling cart. TV was not anchored.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Staff attempted one call to parent following a situation that placed their child at risk. Parent did not answer. Staff did not make any other attempts to parents' work number or emergency contact. Parent was notified almost 40 minutes later about the incident when parent arrived to pick up their child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A child was left unsupervised outside by herself.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was no documentation for the months of December and January.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Upon reviewing children's records, several children were missing information: Healthcare information, admission date, Emergency Care Authorization, Food Allergy Information, Operational Policies Information and Healthcare Provider Statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Upon reviewing personnel records, director did not have a copy of her file/required information available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used: Menu's were observed and were not dated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used (26 TAC §746.3313(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was no documentation of drills accessible for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Cots used by children to nap are not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One employee who has a pending status was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children: A first aid kit that was in a classroom was in a drawer that was unlocked, therefore making it easily accessible to children and was within their reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.4001(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - 220-Volt Electrical Connections Covered: Some rooms had outlets that were uncovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - 220-Volt Electrical Connections Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: Operation failed to notify Licensing of a reportable illness within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: 3 staff who have direct access to children do not have background checks completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A weathered wooden structure was lying in the outdoor area where the children play. The structure has rusty nails. Also observed was a pile of cable that was also lying in the outdoor area where children play. I also observed a Lysol spray can disinfectant under an unlocked cabinet door in one of the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: An employee who has direct access to children in care has an Ineligible status.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used: Menu's were observed and were not dated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used (26 TAC §746.3313(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Drills are not being documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - 220-Volt Electrical Connections Covered: Outlets in 3 rooms were observed uncovered. This was corrected at inspection when they were covered by staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - 220-Volt Electrical Connections Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Cots used by children to nap are not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A child was observed going from a water fountain that is near their classroom, back to the classroom. Another child was observed coming from a bathroom back to his classroom. Botth children were unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: Menu's were observed. Menu substitutions  were made and not documented..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))
